scope: Installed vendor libraries/tools and art libraries under Assets, plus all manifest direct packages. Sample libraries are distinguished from required gameplay dependencies. No Unity import/build/runtime test.
size_note: Filesystem payload excluding .DS_Store; includes .meta files. Nested plugin roots overlap. Not build size or imported Library size.

plugins.name: DOTween core + Pro + DemiLib
plugins.installed_version: core DLL 1.2.420; Pro DLL 1.0.244; DemiEditor DLL string 1.0.060
plugins.sprint_recommendation: Use for UI and cosmetic tweens
plugins.purpose: Code tweens, sequences, visual Animation/Path components, TMP animation; DemiLib supports vendor tooling.
plugins.setup_and_api: See 01_DOTWEEN_PRO.md. Use DG.Tweening. Configure modules through the Utility Panel. Add coherent assembly definitions if custom game assemblies need loose modules.
plugins.cautions: DLL product strings do not certify every loose script version. Handle pool return explicitly. Avoid a second core copy and competing Feel/Animator property writers.
plugins.verification: static local inspection; not imported, compiled or run

plugins.name: Feel / MMFeedbacks
plugins.sprint_recommendation: Use a small event-driven subset
plugins.purpose: Inspector-authored coordinated visual, audio, UI, camera and haptic responses.
plugins.setup_and_api: See 02_FEEL.md. Bind MMF_Player and explicit targets; play after an accepted gameplay event. Code namespace MoreMountains.Feedbacks.
plugins.cautions: Online docs are 6.3, with APIs absent locally and a higher minimum Editor. The root includes MMTools, Nice Vibrations and demos; nested inventory sizes overlap.
plugins.verification: static local inspection; not imported, compiled or run

plugins.name: MMTools (bundled with Feel)
plugins.sprint_recommendation: Keep required runtime; adopt utilities only when needed
plugins.purpose: Audio management, pools, progress bars, time helpers and numerous supporting systems used by feedbacks.
plugins.setup_and_api: MoreMountains.Tools namespace. MMSoundManager can own sound tracks/pooling; MMProgressBar displays game values. Inspect the local API index and demo before adopting an optional helper.
plugins.cautions: The runtime assembly is also the target of Feel asmrefs in this checkout. Do not delete it as an optional demo library. Avoid adding another save/time/pool system without a clear owner.
plugins.verification: static local inspection; not imported, compiled or run

plugins.name: Nice Vibrations / Lofelt
plugins.sprint_recommendation: Optional after the loop works
plugins.purpose: Preset, emphasis, continuous and authored-clip haptics, exposed through direct APIs and Feel feedbacks.
plugins.setup_and_api: Prefer MMF_NVPreset/MMF_NVEmphasis through a game haptic adapter. Check MOREMOUNTAINS_NICEVIBRATIONS_INSTALLED per target; Android has the define in this checkout.
plugins.cautions: Device verification required. MMF_Haptics is deprecated. Choose this or CandyCoded per event; do not double-fire. OlderVersions content is not another package that needs importing.
plugins.verification: static local inspection; not imported, compiled or run

plugins.name: LeanTween
plugins.sprint_recommendation: Keep for existing dependencies; prefer DOTween for new work
plugins.purpose: Alternative tween implementation using LeanTween static calls and LTDescr handles.
plugins.setup_and_api: Typical routes are LeanTween.move/scale/value and cancel by the specific tween ID. Framework and examples are separate folders; the readme points to bundled/offline documentation.
plugins.cautions: Do not run LeanTween and DOTween on the same property. Inventory its callers before a later removal. Tween cancellation and pool baseline reset remain necessary.
plugins.verification: static local inspection; not imported, compiled or run

plugins.name: Particle Image
plugins.sprint_recommendation: Optional UI polish
plugins.purpose: Canvas-based particles, attractors, trails, texture-sheet animation, sub-particles and masking.
plugins.setup_and_api: Create GameObject > UI > Particle Image. Runtime type AssetKits.ParticleImage.ParticleImage exposes Play, Pause, Stop, Stop(bool), Clear and AddBurst. Use for reward sparkles in Overlay/Camera Canvas modes.
plugins.cautions: This is not a world ParticleSystem. Its asmdef has Burst/Collections/Mathematics dependencies. Check UI material/masking and particle counts; particle-completion events must not grant currency.
plugins.verification: static local inspection; not imported, compiled or run

plugins.name: Joystick Pack
plugins.sprint_recommendation: Use one chosen joystick with the Input System UI route
plugins.purpose: Fixed, floating, dynamic and variable touch joystick variants; analog Direction/Horizontal/Vertical values.
plugins.setup_and_api: Use a Canvas/GraphicRaycaster and one EventSystem with InputSystemUIInputModule. Assign background/handle and read Direction from a game input adapter. The bundled PDF is Documentaion.pdf (original spelling).
plugins.cautions: Confirmed AxisOptions getter recursion at base Joystick.cs:24; fix before calling it. Top-level folder is prefab/art content, not a proven second script implementation. Prefabs still need input-module verification.
plugins.verification: static local inspection; not imported, compiled or run

plugins.name: TouchControlsKit Lite
plugins.category: touch joystick, button and touchpad framework
plugins.sprint_recommendation: Defer unless retaining a specific existing consumer
plugins.purpose: Named controllers queried through TouchControlsKit.TCKInput; contains first-person examples.
plugins.setup_and_api: GetAxis(controllerName), GetButtonDown(name), GetButton(name), GetButtonUp(name); controllers and names must exist. Review TCKInput initialization before bringing a prefab into the scene.
plugins.cautions: CheckUIEventSystem creates legacy StandaloneInputModule and controls read Input.touchCount. This conflicts with assuming a new-only Input System setup. Do not run a second movement-input route.
plugins.verification: static local inspection; not imported, compiled or run

plugins.name: Crystal Safe Area
plugins.sprint_recommendation: Useful in Sprint 1
plugins.purpose: Fits a RectTransform to Screen.safeArea and responds to screen/orientation changes; includes device simulation options.
plugins.setup_and_api: Add Crystal.SafeArea to the intended HUD safe-area container under the Canvas. Keep full-screen backgrounds outside that constrained container. Validate layout anchors on the chosen aspect ratios.
plugins.cautions: Do not apply it to every nested element or double-apply safe-area compensation. Check scaled Canvas behavior and orientation in the actual game. Simulation is not a replacement for a phone test.
plugins.verification: static local inspection; not imported, compiled or run

plugins.name: Coffee UIEffect / UI Shiny
plugins.sprint_recommendation: Optional upgrade-button polish
plugins.purpose: UIShiny, dissolve, transition, HSV, gradients, shadows and related graphic effects.
plugins.setup_and_api: Add the appropriate Coffee.UIEffects component to a supported Graphic. UIShiny.Play(bool reset=true) and Stop(bool reset=true) exist locally. The bundled README describes components and effect parameters.
plugins.cautions: Old preview version vendored under Assets; current upstream APIs may differ. Do not install a second UPM copy. Test masking, material compatibility and modified mesh/material interactions. Local LICENSE.md is MIT.
plugins.verification: static local inspection; not imported, compiled or run

plugins.name: AwesomeMask
plugins.sprint_recommendation: Later tutorial onboarding
plugins.purpose: Screen overlay with hollow areas to highlight UI/objects and control pointer passthrough.
plugins.setup_and_api: Crazyminds.AwesomeMask.AwesomeMask with AwesomeMaskHollow. Available methods include Add, Remove, SetElementPosition and CanRayCast. Use supplied prefabs/manual when binding highlight shapes.
plugins.cautions: Verify actual raycast behavior before a tutorial can block the screen. Check Canvas coordinate conversion, safe area and aspect ratio. It is not a gameplay unlock/step system.
plugins.verification: static local inspection; not imported, compiled or run

plugins.name: Kinematic Character Controller
plugins.sprint_recommendation: Evaluate only if choosing character-style movement
plugins.purpose: Capsule-based character motor, ground/collision handling and physics movers. This is not a bulldozer driving simulator.
plugins.setup_and_api: Implement ICharacterController callbacks such as UpdateRotation and UpdateVelocity and assign it to KinematicCharacterMotor. Review core separately from walkthrough/example input and camera code.
plugins.cautions: Examples include legacy Input and locally present mobile joystick/TCK dependencies. Do not use a demo as the production input contract. Vehicle collision geometry and pushing need an explicit design.
plugins.verification: static local inspection; not imported, compiled or run

plugins.name: Navmesh Path Draw + legacy NavMeshComponents
plugins.category: navigation route visualization + bundled legacy components
plugins.sprint_recommendation: Later objective/depot route hint
plugins.purpose: Draws a path with LineRenderer; local code has movement/recalculation thresholds, ground projection and direct fallback settings.
plugins.setup_and_api: Assign destination and LineRenderer/material, ground layers and agent settings. Local methods setDestinationAndDrawPath(Transform), Draw() and Stop() are case-sensitive.
plugins.cautions: A line is not vehicle control. Inspect fallback paths for unreachable destinations. Bundled UnityEngine.AI.NavMeshSurface coexists with modern AI Navigation; choose the intended namespace rather than assuming identical components.
plugins.verification: static local inspection; not imported, compiled or run

plugins.name: Pixel Play Off-Screen Indicator
plugins.installed_version: not established; bundled guide filename says 3.0
plugins.sprint_recommendation: Later, if a depot can leave the camera view
plugins.purpose: Targets with off-screen arrows, boxes and distance labels, with associated indicator pools.
plugins.setup_and_api: Bind the camera and Canvas/indicator prefabs in OffScreenIndicator. Add Target to desired objects. Target enable/disable calls SetTargetState; configure NeedBoxIndicator/NeedArrowIndicator/NeedDistanceText in its Inspector.
plugins.cautions: Target and indicator classes have broad/global names; use a game namespace for your code. Validate camera behind/front tests, safe-area boundaries and despawn cleanup. ExtendedFlycam is a demo camera, not production vehicle input.
plugins.verification: static local inspection; not imported, compiled or run

plugins.name: LitJson
plugins.sprint_recommendation: Use only if the chosen data format needs it
plugins.purpose: JsonData/JsonReader/JsonWriter and JsonMapper conversions between objects and JSON.
plugins.setup_and_api: Use LitJson.JsonMapper.ToJson and ToObject<T> with deliberate data transfer types. Add schema versioning, validation, defaults and migration rules at the game layer.
plugins.cautions: A serializer is not a complete save system. Avoid multiple serializers for one save schema; verify IL2CPP/reflection/stripping behavior for chosen types and corrupted-file recovery on Android.
plugins.verification: static local inspection; not imported, compiled or run

plugins.name: CandyCoded Haptic Feedback
plugins.sprint_recommendation: Alternative to Nice Vibrations, not an additional simultaneous route
plugins.purpose: Simple LightFeedback, MediumFeedback and HeavyFeedback calls with Android/iOS bridges.
plugins.setup_and_api: API namespace/type CandyCoded.HapticFeedback.HapticFeedback. Keep a game-level preference/throttle and call one selected provider only. Inspect native target import and AndroidJNI module dependency.
plugins.cautions: Package JSON is vendored in Assets, not installed as a manifest dependency. No device test was run. The local package metadata declares MIT; retain original notices.
plugins.verification: static local inspection; not imported, compiled or run

plugins.name: Unity Logs Viewer / Reporter
plugins.sprint_recommendation: Development-only option after input adaptation
plugins.purpose: Shows console logs in a running game, traditionally opened with a circle gesture.
plugins.setup_and_api: Bundled README describes Reporter > Create and script execution order. Inspect Reporter/Reporter.cs and ReporterGUI.cs. Verify opening/closing without intercepting normal gameplay.
plugins.cautions: Reporter uses UnityEngine.Input touch/mouse calls and needs attention under new-only input. Keep logs bounded and avoid shipping noisy debug UI or sensitive game/session data in release builds.
plugins.verification: static local inspection; not imported, compiled or run

plugins.name: Asset Cleaner (with internal LeoECS helper)
plugins.sprint_recommendation: Use later for a reviewed cleanup
plugins.purpose: Reference/search and cleanup tooling. The vendored LeoECS sources support the tool, not an established gameplay ECS architecture.
plugins.setup_and_api: Inspect the editor window/menu entry and search results. Start with reference inspection and a reversible cleanup plan.
plugins.cautions: AssetCleaner.asmdef explicitly targets Editor. Do not flag its UnityEditor usages as player failures based only on folder names. Dynamic/string loads and Resources require manual review before deleting assets.
plugins.verification: static local inspection; not imported, compiled or run

plugins.name: MiniGames / Tiny Trail
plugins.sprint_recommendation: Later vehicle/tool visual trail
plugins.purpose: Builds a mesh trail along an array of points, with duration, material and corner settings.
plugins.setup_and_api: Use Tiny.Trail; configure Points, material and duration. Clear() exists for restarting from a new position. The source header contains an MIT-style permission notice.
plugins.cautions: A generated visual trail is not persistent tire tracks or terrain deformation. Check Clear and enable/pool behavior, URP material and mesh allocations before frequent reuse.
plugins.verification: static local inspection; not imported, compiled or run

plugins.name: Epic Toon FX
plugins.sprint_recommendation: Use a small curated set
plugins.purpose: Large selection of impact, dust, explosion, environment, pickup and reward prefabs.
plugins.setup_and_api: Choose a few prefabs, inspect their components, then create game-owned variants. Drive playback from Feel or one VFX service. ETFXLightFade, ETFXPitchRandomizer and ETFXRotation are small supporting scripts.
plugins.cautions: Largest source folder. Old URP notes do not prove Unity 6 renderer compatibility. Check lights, soft particles, sound, stop action and demo scripts before pooling. No visual preview was run in this project.
plugins.verification: static local inspection; not imported, compiled or run

plugins.name: JMO Cartoon FX Remaster + Easy Editor
plugins.sprint_recommendation: Reference helpers; no ready VFX library here
plugins.purpose: The local folder contains 16 C# scripts and metadata, including effect behavior, particle text and material/shader editor helpers. No prefabs, textures, materials or shaders were found in this root.
plugins.setup_and_api: Inspect CFXR_Effect before integrating a separately supplied, licensed complete effect. Its camera-shake and auto-disable/destroy behavior need one clear owner. Particle text needs its supporting assets.
plugins.cautions: Do not ask the agent to select a Cartoon FX prefab from this checkout: none was found. Camera shake can duplicate Feel. Demo Kino Bloom is not the URP bloom setup. Source presence does not imply a complete installed asset pack.
plugins.verification: static local inspection; not imported, compiled or run

plugins.setup_and_api: Treat SparkleLoopEffect and other controllers as sample code. Choose an actual existing Epic Toon FX or Particle Image effect for current implementation instead.
